description: Defines the ApiParameterError class used for representing API parameter error details, including messages, parameter info, and error arguments.

classes.name: ApiParameterError
classes.description: Represents detailed information about an API parameter error, including messages, parameter name, value, and message arguments.

methods.name: generalError
methods.description: Creates an ApiParameterError instance for a general error with a globalisation code and user message.

methods.name: resourceIdentifierNotFound
methods.description: Creates an ApiParameterError indicating a resource identifier was not found.

methods.name: parameterError
methods.description: Creates an ApiParameterError for a specific parameter error with a globalisation code and user message.

methods.name: parameterErrorWithValue
methods.description: Creates an ApiParameterError for a parameter error including the parameter's value.

methods.name: getDefaultUserMessage
methods.description: Returns the default user message string.

methods.name: getUserMessageGlobalisationCode
methods.description: Returns the globalisation code for the user message.

methods.name: getParameterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter related to the error.

methods.name: setParameterName
methods.description: Sets the parameter name related to the error.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the parameter that caused the error.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns the list of message arguments related to the error.
